hints: Take the first word, then ask the same question of the rest of the letters.
So the answer for a position is: for every dictionary word that starts there, that word followed by each answer for the position after it.
Notice what that means - the answer depends only on the position, not on how you got there. So it can be computed once and reused.
Remember the list of readings for each position the first time it is worked out. Without that, a suffix reachable in many ways is solved once per way.
